Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 6

“One who sits restraining the organs of action while dwelling in the mind on the objects of sense is called a hypocrite, a deluded soul.”

Krishna's harshest word so far, aimed at performed renunciation. The body is still, the mind is at the feast — an outward austerity quietly concealing an inward indulgence.
